prompt: Turn a numeric score into a letter grade with an if / else-if chain. Complete the letterGrade method, remembering to reject scores outside 0 to 100 first.
explanation: The invalid check must come first: if score >= 90 were tested before it, 101 would wrongly earn an "A". After that guard, an if / else-if chain testing the boundaries from high to low needs only the lower bound of each band -- when score >= 80 runs, the earlier branch already ruled out 90 and above. The final else catches everything below 60.
hints: Test score < 0 || score > 100 first and return "invalid" before any grade logic runs.
Order the remaining branches from highest cutoff to lowest: >= 90, then >= 80, and so on.
Because each else-if only runs when the earlier tests failed, you never need to write ranges like score >= 80 && score < 90.
